onenight.title: Une nuit
onenight.kicker: One night ashore · pick the stretch of the cape you are moored off · walking order
onenight.lede: This coast eats early and closes early: the sun goes into the channel between about 18:15 and 18:45, kitchens stop between 22:00 and 23:00, and the beach between the villages is no walk after dark. Each quarter below is one evening, in the order you walk it; every name opens its full card.
onenight.door_en: Crew ashore for one evening: a plan for each quarter of the cape — the sunset, the table, the last drink, in walking order.
onenight.door_note: Le coucher · la table · la braise · le dernier verre

quarters.name: Kendwa sand
quarters.line: One beach, faced west: stand in the sea for the sunset, eat on the sand, finish at the old bar.

steps.name: The last hour on Kendwa sand
steps.ref: card:The last hour on Kendwa sand
steps.text: Walk north from the Kendwa Rocks cluster toward the Kilindi headland and be in the water when the sun goes down past Tumbatu. Free, about twenty minutes each way.

steps.name: Gold Zanzibar, on the sand
steps.text: Back along the beach to the south end: the grilled catch of the day or the coconut-and-spice curry at a table on the sand. Resort prices; booking advisable if you are not staying.

steps.name: Kendwa Rocks
steps.text: A cold Kilimanjaro at the bar where the Full Moon Party began in 1996; the kitchen serves to 23:00. On Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday The Rocks Lounge opens at 22:00, after most kitchens on the beach have shut: eat first.

quarters.after: Cheaper: [[venue:fisherman-local|Fisherman Local Restaurant]] on the road behind Eden Villa, grilled lobster at about half the beach-front rate; cash, and go early, the kitchen runs out. Listings disagree on its hours: call +255 777 871 130 first. Spend more: the last of the light at [[venue:zuri-zanzibar|Bahari Grill at Zuri]], booked.

quarters.name: Nungwi west · the strip
quarters.line: A roof for the sunset, the deck below it for dinner, burgers behind the main beach until late.

steps.name: Rooftops at The Z
steps.text: Happy hour runs 17:00 to 20:00, with a DJ on Wednesdays and Saturdays, and the roof fills before the sun goes: no reservations, so arrive early or stand. Adults only (16+); US$15 minimum spend for non-residents, 2% on cards (reviews, 2026).

steps.name: Sexy Fish
steps.text: Downstairs at The Z, on the west deck: tuna ceviche, lobster tempura, crab curry. Book the table; last food orders 21:45, and reviewers find service slow, so order early. Closed April and May for the long rains.

steps.name: CHE Rock
steps.text: Along the sand to the main beach and just behind it, by Pasha Hotel on Nungwi Beach Street: a burger and a cocktail among the strip's own staff. Open 16:30 to midnight by its one listing: call before you count on the last hour.

quarters.after: If Sexy Fish is full: [[venue:langi-langi|Langi Langi]]'s terrace on the water, or [[venue:maisha-beach|Maisha Beach]], grilled seafood on the sand until 23:30 (music nights change with the season: ask). Settle the taxi home before the first drink: [[card:This coast closes early|this coast closes early]].

quarters.name: Nungwi village · the point
quarters.line: The lighthouse at dusk, then a village kitchen: no alcohol, shoulders and knees covered.

steps.name: Ras Nungwi Lighthouse
steps.text: Stand at the island's northern tip with your back to the 1926 tower: both coasts at once, then the light comes on. Exterior only, free.

steps.name: Combo 1990
steps.text: Back through the lanes into the village for the Swahili tapas: five local dishes with rice or ugali and chapati, until 23:00. Cash, no alcohol. Sources disagree on whether it opens on Mondays: call +255 769 720 873.

steps.name: Chipsi mayai, from a cart
steps.text: Chips set in an omelette, the egg just set, from a cart at the market end of the beach, on the nights the carts are out. Cash, small notes.

quarters.after: If Combo is full: [[venue:machnoo|Machnoo]] by the Sharp football ground, pweza wa nazi until 22:30; we could not confirm it in October 2026, so call +255 776 007 954 before you walk over. Avoid Friday around midday, when the village is at prayers.

quarters.name: Nungwi north · the working beach
quarters.line: The quiet end of the sand, then the cheapest good meal on this coast, off the coals at the landing.

steps.name: Mahi Mahi
steps.text: A drink on the quiet northern stretch of Nungwi sand, a walk from the bar strip; open until about 23:00 (Oct 2026).

steps.name: Nungwi fish market, the evening grills
steps.text: The charcoal fires up from about 18:00 until the fish runs out: a whole nguru weighed off the ice and grilled, with rice and kachumbari. Agree the price per kilo before it goes on the coals. Cash.

steps.name: Highland Bungalows
steps.text: Inland on Baobab Way to the guest-house bar: a cheap beer, football on the screens, at about a third of the beach price. No bar hours are published, so ask at the guest house; the way is unlit: bring a torch and walk back with somebody.

quarters.name: Stone Town · the seafront
quarters.line: A night that needs a bed in town: the fort, the grills, a roof with taarab. You cannot drive back after it.

steps.name: The Old Fort
steps.text: Twenty minutes in the free courtyard of an Omani fort on a Portuguese footprint; it orients the whole seafront.

steps.name: Forodhani Gardens
steps.text: Out of the gate and the stalls are lighting: a sugar-cane juice with lime and ginger, a cup of urojo. Eat only what is cooked in front of you and agree the price first.

steps.name: Emerson on Hurumzi, the roof
steps.text: One seating at 19:00, guests from 18:00: three Swahili courses on rugs, US$45 before drinks, taarab most evenings. Booked with a deposit.

quarters.after: Cheaper: stay at [[venue:forodhani|Forodhani]] until the stalls pack up around 21:00. The taarab, honestly: [[card:No listening bar — hear taarab instead|there is no listening bar here]].

getaway.title: Le week-end
getaway.door_en: Friday night to Sunday afternoon: sunset standing in the sea, the dhow yards at dawn, the lighthouse, Stone Town on the way out.
getaway.door_note: Le coucher · le chantier · le phare · la vieille ville
getaway.kicker: The getaway weekend · Friday night to Sunday afternoon
getaway.lede: The north tip sells itself as sunbeds and a party under the full moon. The real thing is quieter and costs less: the sun going down into open water while you stand in it; hulls shaped by hand on the sand at Nungwi before nine; the village behind the bars and the lighthouse at the point; and, on the road back, the half of the spice story the tours leave out. Every stop below is already in this guide, checked in August and on 7–8 October 2026; where the sources disagree on an hour, the step says call ahead. This reading puts them in order, and tells you what to book before you fly.
book: [[card:Two full moons, two party Saturdays|The moon]] — check it before you book the room: the party is the Saturday nearest the full moon, loud and dear — 24 October and 21 November 2026 on the venue's own calendar (seen 8 October).
[[venue:gold-zanzibar|Gold Zanzibar]] — Friday dinner on the sand: booking advisable for non-residents.
[[venue:sexy-fish|Sexy Fish]] — Saturday, a sunset table on the deck: essential, they go well ahead in high season (closed April and May).
[[card:Stone Town, done in one day|A car for Sunday]] — Kendwa to Stone Town, about 1 h 15; roughly US$50–70 (seen Aug 2026), arranged the day before.

stops.name: The last hour on Kendwa sand
stops.ref: card:The last hour on Kendwa sand
stops.text: Drop the bags and walk straight into the sea. North toward the Kilindi headland the hotels stop and the beach is only beach; the sun goes down past Tumbatu, and nobody sells a ticket.
stops.meta: Kendwa beach · sunset about 18:15–18:45 all year · free

stops.name: Dinner on the sand at Gold Zanzibar
stops.text: The grilled catch of the day at a table on the sand at the south end of the beach, with the beach bar a few steps along.
stops.meta: Kendwa beach, south end · upper resort band · booking advisable for non-residents

stops.name: A Kilimanjaro at Kendwa Rocks
stops.text: Back up the sand to the bar where a beach fire among friends in 1996 became the Full Moon Party. Friday is not a club night: the bar, the sand, an early bed.
stops.meta: Kendwa beach, centre · restaurant 11:00–23:00 (Oct 2026) · low to mid (Aug 2026) · no booking for the bar

days.label: Saturday
days.title: The yards, the village, the point

stops.name: The Nungwi dhow yards, just watching
stops.ref: card:The Nungwi dhow yards, just watching
stops.text: A taxi up the coast, or the sand at low water if the tide table allows it. Four hundred metres past the last bar, hulls stand in frame and an adze takes a curve out of the wood. Ask before you photograph anyone.
stops.meta: North end of Nungwi beach · free to watch · before 09:00 · taxi Kendwa–Nungwi about 20,000 TZS (Aug 2026)

stops.name: Coffee at JF Kili
stops.text: A flat white from the owners' own Kilimanjaro beans, at the truck by the square, the better of their two rooms.
stops.meta: Nungwi main road · 07:30–21:00 (one guide says from 08:00) · low · cash only

stops.name: Nungwi village to the lighthouse
stops.text: Inland, through the dukas, the fruit sellers and the mosques, out along the lanes to the 1926 tower on the northern point. Buy something small on the way. Cover shoulders and knees.
stops.meta: About 40 minutes with stops · village lanes, then coral

stops.name: Mnarani turtle pond
stops.text: Beside the lighthouse: a tidal pool in the coral, village-run since 1993, releasing rehabilitated turtles every February. Know what it is: a captive pond where the animals are handled.

stops.name: Lunch at Combo 1990
stops.text: Back in the village, a few tables off the beach: point at the day's pots and take the five-dish spread, with ugali or rice and a chapati to mop it up. Cash, no alcohol, shoulders and knees covered.
stops.meta: Nungwi village · lunch and dinner to 23:00 (Oct 2026) · low, village pricing

stops.name: A gelato at Mama Mia
stops.text: The hottest hours belong in the shade: an espresso, then a gelato from the cabinet before the flavours run out.
stops.meta: Nungwi beach · kitchen from 12:00, bar from 10:30 (own site, Oct 2026) · mid to upper (reviews, Oct 2026) · no booking

stops.name: Sunset on Rooftops at The Z
stops.text: Arrive at the start of happy hour or you will be standing: the roof faces due west over the channel, and on Saturdays a DJ plays the sunset.
stops.meta: The Z Hotel, Nungwi · happy hour 17:00–20:00 · adults 16+, no reservations · US$15 minimum for non-residents, 2% on cards (2026)

stops.name: Dinner at Sexy Fish
stops.text: Down to the deck: tuna ceviche, lobster tempura, crab curry. Order early; reviewers find the service slow. Then the booked taxi home: Saturday is a club night at The Rocks Lounge from 22:00 if you want it.
stops.meta: The Z Hotel, Nungwi · dinner 18:30–22:30, last food orders 21:45 (Oct 2026) · upper mid · essential for a sunset table

days.label: Sunday
days.title: Stone Town, on the way out

stops.name: Mangapwani, on the drive
stops.text: Leave Kendwa by eight and stop on the west-coast road: a coral cave with a freshwater spring, and a chamber cut around 1880 that held people until about 1905. Take a guide who tells it properly.
stops.meta: About an hour for both · about US$5 a foreign adult (guides, Oct 2026)

stops.name: Darajani market
stops.text: The fish hall will be finishing; the spice is the point. Cloves loose by weight, oily enough to mark the paper, never in a printed gift box.
stops.meta: Market Street, Stone Town · from dawn · cash, TZS

stops.name: Christ Church & the slave-market memorial
stops.text: The cathedral raised on the island's last open slave market; stoop into the holding chambers beneath, even for a minute. The card gives no Sunday hours: ask your driver or call before you count on it.

stops.name: Lunch at Lukmaan
stops.text: A few minutes' walk: point at four or five trays on the counter, with urojo alongside. Then the car to the airport.
stops.meta: New Mkunazini Road · through the day from breakfast · low, cash, no alcohol

more.title: If you have only one evening
more.text: Happy hour on [[venue:z-rooftop|The Z rooftop]] from 17:00, dinner on the deck at [[venue:sexy-fish|Sexy Fish]], and a taxi booked home before the first drink. Or, cheaper and better: a whole fish off the coals at the [[venue:nungwi-fish-market|Nungwi landing]] from about 18:00.

more.title: The grand night instead
more.text: Move Sunday's Stone Town to Saturday night and sleep there: one seating at 19:00 on the roof at [[venue:emerson-hurumzi|Emerson on Hurumzi]], US$45 before drinks, booked with a deposit. On the cape, [[venue:essque-zalu|The Jetty at Essque Zalu]] is a lunch and moonlight address on the east side: it loses the sunset, and closed Monday to Wednesday in low season (from 16 March 2026, until further notice: call ahead). [[venue:kilindi|Kilindi]] dines its residents only: ask by email before you count on a table.

more.title: This October and November
items: [[card:Two full moons, two party Saturdays|Full Moon Parties]] on Saturday 24 October and Saturday 21 November, on the venue's own calendar (seen 8 October); the full moons follow on Monday 26 October and Tuesday 24 November.
[[card:The humpbacks are leaving|The humpbacks are leaving]]: a fair chance in early October, falling week by week; by November a sighting is luck.
[[card:Between the two winds|Between the two winds]]: the calmest sea of the year off the north tip, the window for Leven Bank (advanced divers) and Mnemba.
[[card:The short rains, wetter than usual|The short rains]] are forecast wetter than usual from October into January: check warnings before a long boat day.
[[card:Nyerere Day, Wednesday 14 October|Nyerere Day]], Wednesday 14 October: withdraw cash the day before.

more.title: Where to sleep
more.text: We have judged these places for a meal or a drink, not for a night: we have not priced or stayed in the rooms. Hotels already in this guide: [[venue:kilindi|Kilindi]], fifteen domed pavilions at the quiet north end of Kendwa; [[venue:zuri-zanzibar|Zuri]] and [[venue:gold-zanzibar|Gold Zanzibar]] on Kendwa sand; [[venue:kendwa-rocks|Kendwa Rocks]], loud on club and party nights; on Nungwi's west beach [[venue:langi-langi|Langi Langi]]; and in Stone Town, for the roof, [[venue:emerson-hurumzi|Emerson on Hurumzi]].

more.title: What we would leave out
more.text: The turtle aquarium that charges to feed and swim with captive animals: see them wild at [[card:Mnemba Atoll|Mnemba]] ([[card:The turtles, honestly|the turtles, honestly]]). Anyone selling a tour inside the [[card:House of Wonders|House of Wonders]], closed since its 2020 collapse. Any boatman promising a landing on Mnemba. Spice in a printed gift box. And the beach between Kendwa and Nungwi after dark, in either direction.
